supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends laterally beyond the ocular orbits toward the temporal margins.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between a lighter muzzle and a darker, heavily freckled periocular and cheek region.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thin vertical profile with a straight, neutral baseline and no visible droop.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive dark pigmentation spots/freckling localized across the cheeks and sub-nasal area.
